shared_head:
You are a game programmer. Write ONE complete self-contained HTML5 canvas game in a single code block. Vanilla JS only, no assets, no network. COMPACT CODE: under 450 lines, short names, dense style — the file MUST fit in your output budget, so cut juice before mechanics. End with . FIRST LINES OF THE FILE (copy exactly): an error banner so any crash shows on screen: SWARM
THE GAME — 'SWARM': a vampire-survivors-style SIDESCROLLER (side view, gravity, jump). MECHANICS (all required, working): 1. Player: A/D or arrows move, W/Space/Up jump (coyote time 0.1s), flat ground + 2-3 floating platforms. Character auto-attacks the nearest enemy every weapon cooldown — a thrown knife/arc. Weapon fires toward nearest enemy automatically (that is the genre: you only move). 2. Enemies: spawn from left and right edges in waves, walk toward player, contact damage. 3 types: walker (slow tank), runner (fast, low hp), flyer (sine-wave, ignores platforms). HP/damage/spawn-rate scale with elapsed time. 3. Kills drop XP gems (small green diamonds) that fly to the player when close (magnet radius). Fill the XP bar -> LEVEL UP: game pauses, show 3 random upgrade cards (click or press 1/2/3). Upgrade pool (at least 8): +damage, +fire rate, +projectile (knife pierces), +extra projectile (spread), +move speed, +max hp +heal, +magnet radius, +orbiting blade (rotates around player, damages on contact). 4. Survival is the score: big timer top-center. Death -> screen with time survived + kills + best time (localStorage). No victory state — the horde always wins eventually; the run is the story. Difficulty steps up every 30s (announce in a small toast: 'the night deepens'). 5. Juice (only if budget remains): hit flash, screen shake on level-up, particles on kill, damage numbers. QUALITY BAR: fixed/delta-time loop, AABB collisions, camera subtle-follows in world slightly wider than screen (or single-screen arena — your choice, keep it simple), letterbox canvas, title screen 'SWARM — move with A/D, everything else is automatic — press any key'. No crashes when many entities overlap (cap arrays: enemies<=120, gems<=200, projectiles<=80, particles<=150). OUTPUT: one complete HTML file in a single code block. No explanations.

lanes.context: Variant A: single-screen arena (camera fixed, world = one screen) for maximum solidity. Tighter, fewer bugs, arena pressure from both sides feels like a pit.
lanes.task: Write the complete game per the spec.

lanes.context: Variant B: wider world (2-3 screens) with camera follow and a ground line + platforms; favor the orbiting-blade build path and spread-shot synergy.
lanes.task: Write the complete game per the spec.

lanes.context: Variant C: single-screen, but the horde comes in distinct 30-second waves with a 3s breather between (telegraphed 'wave 2' style), boss-lite every 2 minutes (one big walker with an hp bar).
lanes.task: Write the complete game per the spec.
